# Module: modal-product.js

**Responsibility:** Product detail/edit modal — open, close, toggle edit mode, save (`PUT /api/products/:id`), and the placeholder P.I.S.T.A. chat panel.
**Location:** `ui_design/js/controllers/database/modal-product.js`
**Depends on:** `state.js` (`currentData`, `API_BASE`, `fmtPrice`), `renderers-master-data.js` (`renderProducts`, to refresh the table after save)
**Consumed by:** `databaseController.js` (side-effect import only, to register `window.*` handlers), `onclick` attributes generated by `renderers-master-data.js`

## Exports

None — all handlers are registered on `window`: `openProductModal`, `closeProductModal`, `handleProductModalBgClick`, `toggleProductEdit`, `saveProductModal`, `sendProductChat`.

## Key Concepts

- Same open/edit/save/mutate-in-place pattern as `modal-supplier.js` and `modal-customer.js` — private local state (`modalProduct`, `productEditMode`), not shared.
- `saveProductModal` parses `unit_price` and `prod_supp_id` as numbers before sending (`parseFloat`/`parseInt`) since the source inputs are plain text/number fields.

## What is NOT here

- Supplier/Customer/Order modals — see the sibling `modal-*.js` files
- Product table rendering — see `renderers-master-data.js`
